Sell a rental and delay the tax bill. It's called a 1031 exchange.

Normally you owe tax on the gain when you sell. With a 1031, the money goes to a qualified intermediary (a middleman), not you, and buys your next investment property.

The clock: 45 days to identify it, 180 days to close.

The tax is deferred, not erased. Strict rules, so work with a tax pro. dealcaddie.ai

Sell a rental and delay the tax bill: the 1031 exchange, explained.

When you sell an investment property for a profit, you normally owe tax on the gain. A 1031 exchange lets you defer it: the proceeds go to a qualified intermediary, not to you, and are used to buy your next investment property.

The clock is strict: 45 days to identify the replacement, 180 days to close.

The tax is deferred, not erased, so more of your capital keeps working. This is education, not tax advice. Work with a tax professional.
